propositions: Cancelled ACLI link-delete commands (EOF on confirmation prompt) are miscounted as applied, inflating links_applied and silencing the canary via over-reporting

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments links_applied for all failures, treating them as idempotent races when most are not, and has no logging so the divergence is invisible
acli 1.3.19-stable (fleet-cached version) accepts --yes flag on both link subcommands but the call sites omit it, causing the confirmation prompt to read EOF and fail deterministically every pass
The narrowed idempotent detector must check both stderr and stdout for 404/409/not-found markers, mirroring the precedent in delete_issue, to avoid false alarms on stdout-carried markers
A new links_failed counter must be added to the outcome tuple and reported in batch_outcome to make failures visible to the silent-divergence canary
Passing --yes to both link subcommands eliminates the deterministic EOF failure and prevents the root cause
